title: Resolve landing pull request merge conflicts
summary: Merged origin/main into feat/landing for pull request #24 and resolved the conflicts in the EVE cache and embedded UI distribution. The UI distribution was rebuilt from the merged source so index.html points at a fresh generated JS/CSS pair, and the EVE cache was reconciled to include snapshots from both branches until this resolution snapshot updates it.
userVisibleChange: Pull request #24 is no longer blocked by merge conflicts; the landing page branch includes the latest main branch changes.

risks.title: Generated asset hashes changed
risks.mitigation: The embedded UI distribution was rebuilt from merged source and the build completed successfully.

risks.title: EVE cache is generated metadata
risks.mitigation: The merge commit reconciled the cache, and this EVE snapshot will update the cache again to the current committed state.

timeline.title: Ran merged-branch checks
timeline.summary: Verified Go, UI, site, Swift, conflict marker, unmerged path, and whitespace checks.

decisions.title: Regenerate embedded UI assets from merged source
decisions.rationale: The UI distribution conflict was caused by hashed build artifacts. Rebuilding from the merged UI source avoids choosing stale assets from either side and produces a consistent index.html and asset pair.

decisions.title: Keep the latest landing snapshot as cache latest
decisions.rationale: The snapshots from main were older than the landing branch's latest snapshot, so the reconciled cache keeps the landing path-dot fix as the latest snapshot while including main's additional snapshot counts.

decisions.title: Restore generated Next env churn
decisions.rationale: The site build rewrote site/next-env.d.ts. That generated change was unrelated to the merge resolution, so it was restored before committing.

validation.output: No unmerged files remained before commit.
No conflict markers found outside generated/minified asset exclusions.
Vite built successfully and copied the merged UI bundle into cmd/eve/ui_dist with index-BY-dyVNI.js and index-WwcKAnMz.css.
Next.js production build completed successfully; 20 static pages generated.
